solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Upset, as one is after haircut?

definitions.meaning: upset in the sense of troubled or anxious
read playfully, someone just shorn has lost their tresses

explanation.surface: Someone is upset, and the clue wonders if a bad trip to the barber is to blame.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a pun: DIS- as 'without' plus TRESSES, the locks of hair cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: Distressed is a standard synonym for upset or troubled; the haircut sense is a playful split of the word.

clue.text: Most wander about, going with the flow

indicators.note: about signals moving the letters around, so the letters of most wander are rearranged

explanation.surface: Most people drift aimlessly, simply going along with the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going with the flow' looks idiomatic, meaning conforming, but here it is literal: travelling with the river's current.
explanation.definitionFit: Something travelling downstream moves in the same direction as the current of a river.

clue.text: Endlessly search for spy

indicators.note: endlessly tells us the search word loses its final letter

parts.note: to search for something is to seek it

explanation.surface: An instruction to hunt without stopping for a secret agent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spy' looks like a noun, an agent, but it is the verb meaning catch sight of.
explanation.definitionFit: To spy something is to catch sight of it, the same as to see it.

clue.text: Fiendish Tories holding power in quick return

indicators.note: holding means the jumbled party letters wrap around the power letter
fiendish suggests something wildly twisted, so the letters of Tories are scrambled

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: Wicked Conservative politicians keep a grip on power, answering their critics swiftly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fiendish' turns TORIES into RIOSTE, and 'holding' puts P inside it after the I. Tories are members of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A riposte is a swift, sharp reply in an argument; originally a fencer's quick counter-thrust.

clue.text: Over-inquisitive dog drawn into boxes

definitions.meaning: describing someone who pries too much into other people's business
the beagle from the Peanuts comic strip, drawn into the panels of each strip

explanation.surface: A nosy dog gets sketched into the panels of a cartoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boxes' are the panels of a comic strip, not containers.
explanation.definitionFit: Snoopy is both an adjective meaning prying and the name of Charles Schulz's cartoon beagle.

clue.text: Duck, European red one, turning up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the letters for red and one are read from bottom to top

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A duck from Europe, red in colour, is spotted turning up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turning up' reverses RED plus I to IDER, put after E.
explanation.definitionFit: The eider is a large sea duck famed for the soft down used in eiderdowns.

clue.text: Full-bodied tirade about beak rising

indicators.note: about means the rant letters are placed around the other piece

parts.note: a tirade is a long angry rant

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word for beak is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: beak is slang for a nose

explanation.surface: A rich-sounding harangue about some magistrate getting above himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beak' looks like British slang for a magistrate, which suits the courtroom surface, but here it is the nose. 'Rising' and 'about' do their usual down-clue work.
explanation.definitionFit: A resonant voice or sound is deep, rich and full, so full-bodied describes it.

clue.text: Puppy initially wants assistance

indicators.note: initially means take just the opening letter of wants

explanation.surface: A young dog, from the start, is wanting some help.
explanation.definitionFit: A whelp is a young dog, a pup newly born to a bitch.

clue.text: Very many dogs could be missing lead

indicators.note: missing lead means the dog word drops its first letter

parts.note: poodles are a breed of dog

explanation.surface: Lots of dogs are running about without leads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' looks like a dog's leash, but it means the leading letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Oodles is informal for a great quantity, lots and lots.

clue.text: A referee enters wearing football shoes — or not?

definitions.text: A referee enters wearing football shoes — or not?

indicators.note: enters means the article and the official go inside the other word

explanation.surface: A referee walks on, but is he actually wearing boots or not?
explanation.walkthrough: The clue builds the word from BOOTED and then questions it: 'or not?' turns the booted official into one with bare feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Barefooted means having no shoes on, the opposite of the booted state the wordplay uses.

clue.text: Japanese wrestling is endless problem

indicators.note: endless tells us the wrestling word loses its last letter

parts.note: sumo is the traditional Japanese wrestling sport

explanation.surface: Japanese wrestling is presented as an unending headache.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum is an arithmetic problem, as set to schoolchildren.

clue.text: Chap I make better, giving treatment for nails

parts.note: to make better is to cure

explanation.surface: A man boasts that he heals people, offering to fix their nails.
explanation.definitionFit: A manicure is a cosmetic treatment of the hands and fingernails.

clue.text: Prove a sun exploding could make this

definitions.text: Prove a sun exploding could make this

indicators.note: exploding blows the letters of prove a sun apart into a new order

explanation.surface: Demonstrate that a star blowing up could create this.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal doubles as the definition: a sun exploding does make what the letters spell.
explanation.definitionFit: A supernova is the brilliant explosion of a star at the end of its life.

clue.text: First coat of plaster to present for inspection

definitions.meaning: the base layer of plaster or cement applied to a wall
to hand over or submit, as in submitting an account

explanation.walkthrough: 'First coat of plaster' tempts a first-letter pick, P; it is a whole definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Render is both the builder's first coat on a wall and a verb meaning submit, as in rendering a bill.

clue.text: Get away from Francesca Peroni

indicators.note: from means the letters are drawn out of the words Francesca Peroni

explanation.surface: Someone flees from a woman named Francesca Peroni.
explanation.walkthrough: Peroni is also an Italian beer, which gives a second picture.
explanation.definitionFit: To escape is to get away from confinement or danger.

clue.text: US politician's upsetting treason

indicators.note: upsetting suggests knocking over and disordering the letters of treason

explanation.surface: An American lawmaker's treachery causes distress.
explanation.definitionFit: A senator is a member of the US Senate, the upper house of Congress.

clue.text: Pause in the middle in this late rush

indicators.note: in the middle means take the central letters of each of the words this, late and rush

explanation.surface: A break is called halfway through a frantic last-minute dash.
explanation.walkthrough: Each four-letter word gives its two central letters: HI, AT, US.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus is a gap or break in continuity, an interruption.

clue.text: Agreement on including one instrument

indicators.note: including means the numeral is taken inside the combined words

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A deal is struck about one musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The accordion is a portable musical instrument played with bellows and keys.

clue.text: Car user losing key in Thames, perhaps

indicators.note: losing means a letter is dropped from the car-user word

parts.note: someone using a car is its driver

explanation.surface: A motorist loses their car keys in London's great waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' looks like a car key; it is the musical key D. The Thames is London's river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Thames is an example of a large flowing watercourse, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: What tattooist includes excessively

indicators.note: includes means the letters sit within the word tattooist

explanation.surface: A query about what a tattoo artist overdoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Too means to an excessive degree, as in too much.

clue.text: Hedging shrub I check thoroughly after pruner has cut middle

indicators.note: after puts the remaining pieces behind what is left of the gardening word
has cut middle means the gardening word loses letters from its centre, keeping only its start

parts.note: to vet is to check thoroughly

explanation.surface: A gardener inspects the hedge after trimming its middle.
explanation.walkthrough: The trim is loose: 'has cut middle' keeps only the head of the gardening tool, losing its centre and tail (UNER), not just the centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Privet is an evergreen shrub widely planted for garden hedges.

clue.text: Breakfast item for health?

definitions.meaning: grilled bread eaten in the morning
a drink raised to someone's health

explanation.walkthrough: 'For health?' is a cryptic hint at raising glasses and saying 'Your health!'.
explanation.definitionFit: Toast is browned bread at breakfast, and also a salute drunk to someone's good health.

clue.text: Fit a small part

parts.note: PT is the abbreviation for part, the small form of the word

explanation.surface: Suitable for a minor role.
explanation.definitionFit: Apt means suitable or appropriate, as does fit used as an adjective.

clue.text: Foiled awful fraudster — about time

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go around the time letter
awful suggests something badly made, so the letters of fraudster are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dreadful conman is finally thwarted, and not before time.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone foiled has been thwarted, prevented from succeeding.
